integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Vintage film. A selkie waits alone in a laundromat at 3 a.m. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Beyond the windows, a glittering sun shower.

overall_soundscape: A clock ticks and wind presses against old glass.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, sparse acoustic guitar line that fades out.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. A red panda waits alone in a snowed-in train station. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Beyond the windows, a gathering thunderstorm.

overall_soundscape: A clock ticks and wind presses against old glass.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, sparse acoustic guitar line that fades out.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. A selkie waits alone in a greenhouse on the moon. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Beyond the windows, a gathering thunderstorm.

overall_soundscape: A clock ticks and wind presses against old glass.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, sparse upright bass line that fades out.
